role: The A* open set: a binary min heap of PathPoints keyed on distanceToTarget, with the grow, the dequeue and the changeDistance re-sort.
scope_reason: Mob pathfinding is vanilla behavior the mob AI depends on.

members.name: pathPoints
members.note: the heap and the point pool are flat arrays in struct pf; no grow is needed at the pool's fixed capacity

members.name: clearPath
members.note: each search resets the heap in setup()

members.name: sortBack
members.note: the tie behavior is kept: a child never rises on an equal key

members.name: sortForward
members.note: on a tie the left child wins, as in vanilla

members.name: isPathEmpty
members.note: the predicate is the search loop's condition

notes: The 1024 slot array and its doubling grow are replaced by struct pf's fixed capacity pool (pathfind.h header comment); the heap's tie quirks are spelled in pathfind.c's comments.
